messages:
marie-sec: Heads up — seeing intermittent SCIM provisioning errors in prod since last night's KMS rotate. A few service accounts lost external IDs and RBAC lookups are returning 404s. Audit shows Decrypt failures for the new key alias. Anyone on idp/infra?

ajay-idp: Noticed alerts too, pinging now. Which alias was rotated?

marie-sec: alias/redwood-prod-2026-03-22. Logs show a mix of successful and failed decrypts (same alias). Snippet: 
```
2026-03-22T22:04:12Z scim-provisioner ERROR svc=provisioner-2 kms:Decrypt failed alias/redwood-prod-2026 error=InvalidCiphertextException
2026-03-22T22:04:12Z scim-provisioner WARN svc=provisioner-2 payload_id=svcacct-901 http_status=500
```

kevin-sre: hmm. Could be partial rewrap/replication or an IAM policy timing issue for the re-encrypt job. Any RBAC policy changes around the provisioner role?

marie-sec: No RBAC changes on our side. The rewrap job ran from the orchestration cluster at 21:48 UTC. We still have the old alias alias/redwood-prod (no suffix) pointing to previous key.

ajay-idp: That matches a known race where some instances used cached DEK wrapped with the old key. If rewrap didn't atomically update both metadata and cached envelopes, you get mixed decrypt results. Can you confirm which hosts saw failures?

marie-sec: failures concentrated on provisioner-2 and provisioner-7 in us-east-1. Most other hosts OK.

kevin-sre: Quick mitigation: restart affected provisioner replicas so they reload envelope metadata and DEKs. Also pause any canary rollouts that write to SCIM until we confirm.

marie-sec: restarting provisioner-2 now.

sre-oncall: restarting provisioner-7 as well. Will hold canary batch 3.

deploy-bot: deploy 1910101009 by kevin-sre to provisioner-2 restarted (success)

ajay-idp: After restart, check audit logs for "kms:Decrypt succeeded" entries and ensure envelope keyVersion matches alias/redwood-prod-2026. If mismatch, we need to run a backfill rewrap for remaining envelopes.

marie-sec: post-restart logs show decrypt success for provisioner-2 but provisioner-7 still had 3 failures before succeeding. No new 500s in last 6m.

kevin-sre: Good. Next steps: 1) Schedule a controlled rewrap backfill for any envelopes still referencing the older key; 2) Add a guard in the rewrap job to wait for replication confirmation across regions; 3) Add an alert for mixed-key decrypt errors so we catch this early.

ajay-idp: For 1) I'll prepare a backfill script that checks envelope metadata and re-encrypts if keyVersion!=redwood-prod-2026. Will run dry-run first. For 2) I'll add a replication-check to the orchestration.

marie-sec: Also need to validate RBAC: some downstream services treat missing extID as access denied. We should add a short-lived fallback that treats extID-missing as retryable (not deny) during key ops.

kevin-sre: Agreed. I'll open a small PR to change the provisioner error handling to 429/retry for extID-not-found during maintenance window.

sre-oncall: I'll annotate the incident and update the runbook: add step to check KMS key alias atomicity and restart replicas.

marie-sec: Thanks — assigning followups: ajay -> backfill dry-run + replication guard; kevin -> PR for retry behavior; sre-oncall -> runbook update + postmortem stub. I'll monitor for any lingering 500s.

ajay-idp: ETA for dry-run later today, will post results here.

kevin-sre: PR linked when ready.

marie-sec: Closing loop: postmortem will include timeline, root cause (non-atomic rewrap visibility), and two mitigations: replica restart + orchestrator replication check. Thanks all :thumbsup:
